description: This Java source file defines the 'CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor' class, an Akka actor used for monitoring the health status of multiple subsystems by aggregating their individual health reports and caching them for efficient retrieval.

classes.name: CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages and caches the health status of multiple subsystems using child actors, periodically querying and aggregating their health data.
